_comment: The config half of the case, frozen. A case is only reproducible if the style pack it was scored under is pinned beside the script: overlays.density and overlays.emphasis decide how many graphics are even legal, and allowed_components decides which ones exist, so a case re-run under a different pack is a different question. This one is hand-written rather than lifted from a run — it enables the emphasis class deliberately, because the case carries an emphasis mark and a mark the pack forbids would score as a miss the planner could never avoid.
